# azion_waf (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "azion_waf" "example" {
  waf_id = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `waf_id` (Number) The WAF identifier.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of the data source.
- `results` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results))

<a id="nestedatt--results"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results`

Read-Only:

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the WAF is active.
- `engine_settings` (Attributes) Engine settings for the WAF. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results--engine_settings))
- `id` (Number) The ID of the WAF.
- `last_editor` (String) Last editor of the WAF.
- `last_modified` (String) Last modified timestamp.
- `name` (String) Name of the WAF.
- `product_version` (String) Product version of the WAF.
- `state` (String) The state of the current WAF version.
- `version_id` (String) The identifier of the current WAF version.

<a id="nestedatt--results--engine_settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results.engine_settings`

Read-Only:

- `attributes` (Attributes) Attributes for the WAF engine settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results--engine_settings--attributes))
- `engine_version` (String) Engine version for the WAF.
- `type` (String) Type of the WAF engine.

<a id="nestedatt--results--engine_settings--attributes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results.engine_settings.attributes`

Read-Only:

- `rulesets` (List of Number) List of ruleset IDs.
- `thresholds` (Attributes List) Threshold configurations for the WAF. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results--engine_settings--attributes--thresholds))

<a id="nestedatt--results--engine_settings--attributes--thresholds"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results.engine_settings.attributes.thresholds`

Read-Only:

- `threshold` (Attributes) A single threshold configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results--engine_settings--attributes--thresholds--threshold))

<a id="nestedatt--results--engine_settings--attributes--thresholds--threshold"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results.engine_settings.attributes.thresholds.threshold`

Read-Only:

- `sensitivity` (String) The sensitivity level for the threshold.
- `threat` (String) The threat type for the threshold.
